execution_model.source_authority: repository-contained source archives, retained source trees, canonical contracts, and staged native overlay sources

required_proof_chain: static archive and shared overlay library

dialect_projection.alphabetic: canonical interface identity, header, source, target, contract, and provenance lexemes
dialect_projection.numeric: ABI widths, Android API floor, syscall numbers, file sizes, and deterministic counts
dialect_projection.intent: request inventory, classify a native gap, or execute a declared compatibility proof route
dialect_projection.symbolic: interface signatures, headers, types, structs, linker identities, and source/proof hashes
dialect_projection.stamp: source archive, source hash, build flags, exported-symbol proof, and target receipt
dialect_projection.control: inventory generation, materialization, compile, link, run, downstream validation, and fail-closed promotion
dialect_projection.graphics: not applicable unless the source-derived inventory identifies a graphics-native dependency
dialect_projection.audio: not applicable unless the source-derived inventory identifies an audio-native dependency

failure_closed_behavior: No inventory entry, overlay surface, downstream consumer, Rust nightly, LLVM component, CPython component, or declared language runtime may be represented as target-complete without its corresponding actual AArch64 Android build/probe evidence. Unknown requirements remain classified, never silently ignored.
